messages.text: Searched the catalog · GekkoScience KBOX 22 TH/s Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T

At under 12¢, the KBOX's 330W costs you about $28 a month. It's $800 for 22 TH/s.

Honest call: the Magic Miner 40T is $799 for 40 TH/s — nearly double the hashrate for the same money, about $56/month in power at your rate. Cheap power favours it.

The K. ships sooner though. Where's it going to sit — living space, or somewhere noise doesn't matter?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the GekkoScience KBOX numbers for where you live.
